intended_object: A running count of gate indices: the gate index at which Section F of the circuit construction ends, in the internal proof of the Shannon/Lupanov upper bound on circuit size. I inferred this from the docstring and the nearby definitions oC, oD and oE.
explanation: `oF` is one step in a chain of offsets (oC, oD, oE, oF). Each step adds the number of gates the next section of the circuit uses, so `oF` is oE plus 2^qq. It is bookkeeping for the gate indices in an explicit circuit construction, inside an `Internal` module. The literature has no standard object that it formalizes; it is an implementation detail of the proof.
